card.name: Partway through words before "tr"
card.fires_on: Partway through a longer word when the next piece is likely to begin with "tr", such as intr|amuscularly, intr|avenously, KEY|TRUDA. It also fires on word endings like CLINICI|ANS and PERSON|NEL.

modes.label: intra- words
modes.description: The prefix intr or inter before a route word that continues with tr.

modes.label: KEY before TRUDA
modes.description: The first piece of the drug name KEYTRUDA, where the next piece is TR.

modes.label: Word endings in capitals
modes.description: Final pieces of long uppercase warning words.
modes.example: EMPLOYED BY CLINICI<<ANS>> WHO ARE WELL VERSED

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with a piece that starts with "tr".
card.plain: It marks the middle of a long word where the next letters are probably "tr", as in intramuscularly or Keytruda.
